sentences.en: Galaxies contain from tens of millions to trillions of stars.
sentences.zh: 银河系包含数十亿到数万亿颗恒星。

sentences.en: The Andromeda Galaxy is about twenty trillion kilometers from Earth.
sentences.zh: 仙女座星系距离地球大约二十万亿公里。

sentences.en: The world's debt has surpassed the staggering figure of eighty trillion dollars.
sentences.zh: 全世界的债务已经超过了惊人的八十万亿美金。
